property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] LYCANTHROPE: HALF-MAN, HALF-WOLF, HALF-FRENZIED At the beginning of your turn, roll a d6 for all characters with a Lycanthrope trait. [d:1]-[d:3]: Turn Werewolf to a red click of the same number. [d:4]-[d:5]: Turn him to a blue click of the same number. [d:6]: Turn Werewolf to purple click #1.
[Damage] BLOODLUST Do not turn Werewolf's dial when the d6 is rolled for his trait. When Werewolf would clear action tokens, roll a d6. [d:1]-[d:4]: Instead of clearing tokens, turn him to red click #1. [d:5]-[d:6]: Only remove 1 action token. Werewolf has PROTECTED: Outwit.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers

[Trait] RRRRRGHH! At the beginning of your turn roll a d6. [d:4]-[d:6]: Frankenstein's Monster may immediately make a close attack.
[Trait] MY CREATOR Friendly characters with the Scientist keyword can use Support to target Frankenstein's Monster. When a character with the Scientist keyword targets Frankenstein's Monster with Support, his defense value is 14 for that action. If that character is named Dr. Frankenstein, he can use Support even if he or Frankenstein's Monster are adjacent to an opposing character.
